versions.content: Static Service Connection Description: AUTOSAR shall support Static service connection for selected/standardized bindings. Additional information: Static Can be pre-configured (not discovered dynamically at runtime). Selected/Standardized Explicitly defined by AUTOSAR Rationale: Compatibility to Classic platform. Performance, safety and cyber security improvements for service connect. Dependencies: Address info of service provider needs to exist. Service provider needs to be available Use Case: Statically configured connection to services. Supporting Material: –
